about_the_game:
Supporting creators & oden shop owners!

From the oden food stall visual novel "ODEN," we've compiled various resources that can be used in different scenarios, including the featured oden dishes, character illustrations, background materials, and BGM. APNG animated resources are also included!

These can be widely used for video streaming, TRPG sessions, game development, advertisements, and more, for both commercial and non-commercial purposes.
You can also edit and modify the materials, so feel free to create your own original oden arrangements!

Contents

- PNG Files
  • Oden food assets - 7 types with variations
  • Oden garnish assets - 3 types: mustard/hot sake/kettle
  • Character illustrations - 6 types with fixed expressions
  • SD character illustrations - 1 type with expression variations/APNG included
  • Background assets - 2 types: APNG included
  • ODEN logo and logo elements
- WAV Files
  • BGM - 1 track

Terms of Use

Reporting usage and crediting are not required, but we appreciate your help with promotion.

- OK
  • Commercial/non-commercial use
  • Use in creative activities such as video streaming, TRPG, game development, etc.
  • Use in advertisements (oden shops encouraged!)
  • Processing and modifying materials (resizing, cropping, color adjustments, etc.)
- NG
  • Redistribution of materials (including modified versions)
  • Claiming materials as your own creation
  • Creating merchandise using only the materials
  • Use for illegal or harmful purposes
*All materials included are original creations. Copyright belongs to Lobstudio Inc. and OCTO LLC.
*We are not responsible for any issues or damages resulting from the use of these materials.
